name: Neutral-Grip Pull-Up
steps: Grasp the parallel neutral handles of a pull-up bar station at roughly shoulder width with your palms facing each other and hang with straight arms.
Brace your core, engage your shoulder blades down, and keep your legs steady beneath you.
Pull your chest smoothly upward by driving your elbows down toward your sides until your chin clears the handles.
Lower yourself with control all the way back to a full straight-arm hang.
tips: Avoid kicking your legs or craning your neck upward to clear the handles.
Pause briefly at full extension at the bottom so every repetition starts cleanly.
